h1: The 8 Best PS5 Wall Mounts of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best PS5 Wall Mounts 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 8 PS5 wall mounts for the original, Slim and Pro, scored on airflow, hardware, charging, fans and install effort.
summary: The TotalMount is the PS5 wall mount to buy if you want it done cleanly, with a built-in level, vibration dampers and a metal-free housing that stays clear of the console's Wi-Fi antenna. The Hosanwell is the best mount with charging and RGB, the stainless steel cooling-fan kit is the best all-in-one station, and the 33 lb plain brackets are the budget route for anyone who just wants the console off the shelf.
intro: The usual PS5 wall mount mistake is buying for the accessories and ignoring the bracket. Charging docks and RGB strips make a listing look generous, but the part that actually holds a console on a wall is a few millimeters of metal, a screw pattern and a locking point. If that is wrong, nothing else matters.

This ranking covers eight mounts, from simple shelves under $30 to powered stations in the $30 to $50 bracket. We reviewed each listing for compatibility with the original, Slim and Pro, stated load rating, airflow design, controller storage and install steps, and we ranked them by how well the mount does its main job first. Where a listing is vague about hardware, we say so.

products.name: TotalMount PS5 Wall Mount
products.verdict: The most carefully engineered bracket here, with a built-in level, dampers and a drill-free option.
products.description:
The TotalMount fits every PS5 model, including the Slim and Pro, and holds two controllers. Its housing is metal-free so it stays out of the console's Wi-Fi antenna path, rubber dampers cut fan rattle, and a heavy-duty screw locks the mount to the console base. A built-in level and a drill-free install option are included.

It ranks first because it solves problems the powered kits ignore. A mount that quietly transmits fan vibration into drywall or blocks wireless signal is annoying every day, and this one is designed around both. The Hosanwell below adds charging and lights, but gives up the wireless-friendly housing and offers fewer anti-rattle details.

Buy it if you want a clean, low-profile mount behind or beside a wall-mounted TV. The caveat is that there is no charging or fan here, so the console relies on open airflow, and you will still want a free outlet nearby for the console itself.
products.idealFor: Gamers with a wall-mounted TV who want a quiet, secure, tidy install.
products.skipIf: You want controller charging or fans built into the mount.

products.name: Hosanwell PS5 Wall Mount with Charging Station
products.verdict: Iron construction, dual controller charging and customizable RGB, with the option of wall or desk placement.
products.description:
The Hosanwell is a heavy-duty iron mount rated for up to 10 kilograms, with a hollow design matched to the PS5's cooling vents. It charges two controllers in about 2.5 hours, lists support for the DualSense and Edge controllers, and adds RGB lighting with seven single-color modes and six dynamic ones. It can be wall-mounted or set on a desk.

It ranks second because it does the most with a single fixed mount: charging, lighting and flexible placement without fans. Against the fan-equipped stations below it, the Hosanwell is less cluttered and avoids any fan noise. The tradeoff against the TotalMount is that a powered base means more cables and no dedicated Wi-Fi-friendly housing.

It is the right buy for a gaming corner where lighting and charging are part of the look. The honest caveat is that the listing recommends a 6mm drill bit, so plan on actual drilling for wall use, and you need a nearby outlet for the charging base.
products.idealFor: A showcase setup where charging and lighting live on the same mount.
products.skipIf: You want the plainest, quietest install possible.

products.name: PS5 Wall Mount with Cooling Fan, Charging Station and Headset Holder
products.verdict: A stainless steel shelf with two fans, a dual charger, a headset holder and a spare USB port.
products.description:
This stainless steel shelf mount bundles two cooling fans on a vented base, a dual controller charger, a headset holder and an extra USB port. The fans have three speeds through a touch switch plus off, and charging takes about 2.5 hours with LED status lights, blue when done and orange while charging. It works with the original, Slim and Pro, and with the Edge controller.

It ranks third because the Hosanwell and TotalMount lean on simpler engineering, while this kit adds powered parts that can fail or get noisy. What it earns in return is range. Charging and cooling both continue in standby, and the headset hook keeps one gaming spot free of clutter.

It suits people who want a single product for everything near the TV. The caveat is that powered fans add a moving part and a power draw, and the listing gives no load rating, so check the console weight against the stainless frame before you commit.
cons: Fans add noise and a power draw
products.idealFor: A one-product gaming station with charging, cooling and headset storage.
products.skipIf: You dislike fan noise or want fewer powered parts.

products.name: PS5 Wall Mount Kit with Cooling Fans, Charging and 9 RGB Lights
products.verdict: A fan, charging and RGB floating shelf with a level bubble and a screw box.
products.description:
This kit pairs two fans with low, medium and high speeds, two controller charging slots, a headset holder, and RGB lighting with 9 modes that remembers the last setting. It fits the original, Slim and Pro, supports the Edge controller, and charges in about 2.5 hours with red and green LED indicators.

It sits behind the stainless steel station above because the first kit has the cleaner industrial look and mentions a stainless frame. This one adds anti-slip padding, a screw storage box and a bubble level, all of which make installation easier than the rest of the powered kits. That level is the practical difference when the wall is not forgiving.

Buy it if you want RGB and cooling and need the install to be foolproof. The caveat is that, like the other fan kits, there is no stated load rating, and a fan plus nine light modes is a lot of electronics hanging behind a TV.
products.idealFor: A powered, lit-up setup where an easy install matters.
products.skipIf: You want simple hardware with nothing to plug in.

products.name: PS5 Wall Mount in White with 2 Controller Kits
products.verdict: A 33 lb rated white mount with an open-bottom design and two controller holders.
products.description:
This white mount is rated for 33 lb and fits the PS5, Slim and Pro in both disc and digital versions. It uses an open-bottom layout to let air under the console, adds a smooth coating meant to prevent scratches, and ships with 2 controller holders and a step-by-step manual. The listing says setup takes about 15 minutes with a power screwdriver.

It ranks fifth because the TotalMount adds a locking screw, level and dampers that this simple bracket does not mention. The upside is price, since it sits under $30 and carries a rating the powered stations leave unstated. The white finish matches a white console, which is a real design win.

Choose it if you want a bracket that disappears behind a white console and does not need a power outlet. The caveat is that it relies on an open bottom for airflow, so keep it away from enclosed shelves, and the listing does not mention any anti-vibration hardware.
products.idealFor: White-console owners who want a plain, rated bracket.
products.skipIf: You want charging, lighting or active cooling.

products.name: PS5 Wall Mount Kit in Black with 2 Controller Holders
products.verdict: A black, 33 lb rated bracket with model-specific mounting slots and ventilation holes.
products.description:
This black bracket carries a 33 lb rating, ventilation holes and two controller wall holders. You pick the correct mounting slot for the disc, digital, Slim or Pro model, and the contact surfaces are smooth to protect the finish. The listing positions it for use behind a TV or in tight spaces.

It ranks sixth because it is a near twin of the white mount above, with the ventilation-hole airflow the main difference. The slot approach is clever but demands care, and a console placed in the wrong slot will not sit snugly. Against the TotalMount, it gives up the locking screw and level but keeps the same basic function for less.

It works well for a black console and a limited budget. The honest caveat is that the install requires you to read the slot guide before drilling, and the listing says nothing about vibration damping.
products.idealFor: Black console owners who want a rated bracket with model-specific fit.
products.skipIf: You do not want to match slots before drilling.

products.name: PS5 Wall Mount Kit in Black with Open-Bottom Cooling
products.verdict: A sturdy metal bracket rated 33 lb, with a listed 10 minute install.
products.description:
This sturdy metal bracket is rated for 33 lb, uses an open-bottom design for airflow, and has a scratch-resistant surface. It fits the PS5, Slim and Pro in disc and digital versions, and the listing says it includes all necessary hardware and a step-by-step guide with a roughly 10 minute install using a power screwdriver.

It ranks seventh because it brings nothing the other plain brackets lack, apart from a shorter claimed install time. The white and black bracket pair above add controller holders, which this kit does not list. In practice that makes it a bare shelf.

Choose it if the install time or hardware completeness is your deciding factor. The caveat is no controller storage and no vibration or level aids, so you will need your own spirit level and a free hand to mark the wall.
products.idealFor: Anyone who wants the quickest plain bracket install.
products.skipIf: You want controller storage built into the mount.

products.name: ZHSX Adjustable PS5 Shelf Wall Mount
products.verdict: A stainless steel shelf with adjustable length and width, short on stated specs.
products.description:
The ZHSX is a stainless steel shelf mount with adjustable length and width, aimed at the PS5, PS5 Pro and PS5 Slim disc models, and it can hold two controllers plus headphones. The listing frames it as a storage and display solution rather than a precision bracket.

It ranks last because adjustability sounds useful, but adjustable shelves rely on set screws to hold their size, and the listing offers no load rating, install time or hardware description. The digital-edition fit is also not stated, which narrows its compatibility compared with the TotalMount.

It can suit a shelf display where you want a custom width. The caveat is clear: check that your console version matches, and treat the lack of a rating as a reason to keep it under a light-duty console and away from a spot where a fall would cause damage.
products.idealFor: A display shelf where a custom width is the goal.
products.skipIf: You need a stated load rating or a digital-edition fit.

methodology.description: Stated load ratings (33 lb and 10 kg), locking screws and anti-slip padding were weighed above every accessory.

methodology.title: Airflow and cooling
methodology.description: We compared open-bottom and vented designs against active fan kits, since the PS5 exhausts heat through its own vents.

methodology.title: Console compatibility
methodology.description: Fit for the original, Slim and Pro in disc and digital editions was checked against each listing.

methodology.description: Stated install times (10 and 15 minutes), included levels and drill-free options were scored for beginners.

methodology.description: Charging, RGB and headset holders were credited, but offset by the extra cables, fans and failure points they add.

whatMatters.detail: The load rating is the weight the mount is built to carry, and it is the number that keeps a console off the floor. Several brackets here state 33 lb, the Hosanwell states 10 kg, and the powered kits state nothing. Prefer a stated figure, and anchor into studs or proper wall anchors.

A PS5 pulls air in and exhausts it through vents, so a mount that blocks the underside will trap heat. Open-bottom brackets and vented shelves leave those paths clear. Check the product photo for a cutout under the console, and avoid pushing the shelf into an enclosed cabinet.

The original PS5 and the Slim differ in size, and the Pro is different again. A mount marked for disc and digital, Slim and Pro should say so in the title. The slot-based bracket also asks you to pick the right slot, so read the manual before drilling.

Charging docks, fans and RGB lights add convenience, but they also add cables, an outlet requirement and parts that can fail. Charging takes about 2.5 hours on the kits here. Decide whether you want a powered station before you pay for one.

A built-in level, a drill-free option or a screw box separates a smooth install from a crooked shelf. The TotalMount and the RGB kit with a bubble level both help here. Look for these items on the listing, since a crooked console is hard to fix once the holes are drilled.

faq.q: Will these mounts fit the PS5 Slim and Pro?
faq.a: Yes, most listings cover the original, Slim and Pro, in disc and digital. The TotalMount and the Hosanwell state this clearly, while the ZHSX lists only disc models, so confirm your version before ordering.

faq.q: What is the most common PS5 wall mount mistake?
faq.a: Drilling into drywall without a stud or proper anchor. A console is heavier than it looks, and the 33 lb brackets or the Hosanwell's 10 kg rating assume a solid fixing.

faq.q: Is a fan kit worth it over a plain bracket?
faq.a: Only if you play long sessions in a closed space. The stainless steel fan station and the RGB fan kit add airflow, but the plain TotalMount relies on the console's own vents and stays silent.

Listings quote about 10 minutes for the open-bottom black bracket and 15 minutes for the white one. Allow longer for the TotalMount's level and drill-free setup, and expect extra cable work on the powered kits.

faq.q: Can the console overheat on a wall mount?
faq.a: It can if airflow is blocked. Open-bottom brackets and the vented Hosanwell keep the vents clear. Keep gaps behind and beside the console, and do not push any mount into a closed cabinet.

faq.q: Do charging mounts work with the Edge controller?
faq.a: The stainless steel station and the RGB fan kit both list Edge controller support, and the Hosanwell lists DualSense Edge too. Charging takes around 2.5 hours across all three.

finalTake: Buy the TotalMount if you want the cleanest, quietest, best-secured PS5 mount, and you do not need charging. Choose the Hosanwell when you want controller charging and RGB on a solid iron frame, and the stainless steel station for one mount that covers cooling and a headset. For a plain console shelf under $30, the 33 lb brackets do the job, but pick the one that matches your console color.
